annotations.text:
GROCERY BOARD
Opens on the 37 items actually on sale, not all 637. Search reaches the rest.
Names are never truncated. The store moves to a second line so it stops competing with the name.
Tap a row to see all seven stores; tick rows to build a list.

SPLIT MY TRIP
The planner is a destination, not a card buried in the preamble.
Real numbers: this 3-item list is $6.51 at one store, $5.65 across two.
Try the 3-store option — it tells you a third stop saves nothing.

MEAL PREP
No photos needed: cuisine tile + one macro line + a protein-per-dollar bar.
Default sort is value, not price — switch to Cheapest and watch the list stop moving.
Five picks up top; the other 571 sit behind search.

Everything on the left is measured from the live site on 31 August 2026, rendered at 1:1 against the proposal. Grocery prices and recipe macros throughout the canvas are real values pulled from board.json and the live meal prep page — nothing here is invented.
